title: A Galaxy Next Door
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ichiro, a struggling manga artist, has raised his two younger siblings since their father died. His new assistant Goshiki turns out to be a princess from the stars, and an accidental pact binds the two together, so Ichiro must stay near her while they decide whether real love can grow from it.
life_message: Love grows through honest communication, shared responsibility and not trying to control the other person.

content.note: Ichiro's health falters when apart from Goshiki (ANN guide).
